# QuickBooks

Accounting · options checked 2026-10-21 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Intuit publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

All ten are bookkeeping skills — the only vendor set that is. Intuit also publishes the QuickBooks Online MCP Server (intuit/quickbooks-online-mcp-server, 145 tools, writes on by default), indexed as qbo-mcp-server.

How far Mosofin's own connector to this platform has got. This is separate from the tools above.

| | |
|---|---|
| Status | live — Connected today |
